_meta.description: ILM for agent-monitors-joinability-* and agent-monitors-joinability-substrate-* (monthly index agent-monitors-joinability-YYYY-MM as of FRE-1036, was daily YYYY.MM.DD; ~24 docs/day, cheap retention). min_age-based delete from index creation (no rollover write-alias). Retention: 180d, unchanged. FRE-1036 removed the prior rollover action: it required index.lifecycle.rollover_alias, which no template ever set, so every joinability/substrate index was permanently stuck in hot/check-rollover-ready (confirmed live, failed_step_retry_count 32) and the 180d delete phase never fired. Monthly-by-name (this same ticket's pattern for every other family) replaces it. warm forcemerge fires at 32d, matching the user-turn-ratings-policy precedent so the current monthly index isn't merged while still open.
